author: product-requirements-expert
context: Fresh intake for the visit-cancellation request; no PRD edit made. The request lands on two Non-Goals rows confirmed deliberate on 2026-08-08. NG-5 declines changing or cancelling a visit once booked. NG-4 declines deleting an owner, a pet, or a visit. A cancel action that removes the visit from the pet's record is NG-5 and NG-4 together. The dispatch names neither row and states no owner decision on either. adr/2026-08-08-non-goal-deletion-and-visit-amendment.md holds that a request touching either row proceeds only on an explicit owner decision recorded at intake, and that the request never reopens the row by itself. Gate 1 also bounces a Non-Goals change without a verbatim owner quote in scope_overrides. Note: line 1 anchors this dispatch under REQ-VIS-002 in error; that ID is the existing visit-history requirement. Line 2 corrects it to REQ-VIS-003, the ID I would mint.
question: Three answers, please. (1) Do you narrow NG-5 to admit cancelling an upcoming visit? (2) If yes, does cancelling remove the visit record outright, which narrows NG-4 as well, or retain it marked cancelled and drop it from the pet's visit list? (3) Does upcoming mean a visit dated later than today, matching the boundary REQ-VIS-001 already enforces at booking? Recommendation: narrow NG-5 only, and retain the cancelled visit rather than remove it, so NG-4 stands and the booking history under REQ-VIS-002 stays complete. On a yes I mint REQ-VIS-003, rewrite the NG-5 row and its rationale, write a non-goal ADR for the narrowing, and quote your words verbatim in scope_overrides. A yes to outright removal adds an NG-4 entry to the same field. On a no I record the refusal against this request in the non-goal ADR and append no prd-entry. On question 3 I will record the later-than-today reading unless you say otherwise.
stop_state: docs/prd.md, docs/ubiquitous-language.md, and docs/adr/ unchanged; no prd-entry appended. Resume by minting REQ-VIS-003, editing the Non-Goals rows, and drafting the acceptance bullets.
